summary: John's 4th great-aunt; eldest sister of Friedrich Mayer.
bio:
Born 3 Jul 1821 in house No. 68 (tree says 7 Jul, probably the baptism). Godparents: the local citizens and masons Anton Mayer and Joseph Mayer (possible kin of Heinrich) and a single woman Anna [Rothenbacher?]. Married Joseph Wenz (b. 1828) at Munzingen 26 Feb 1857; children Mary Ann (1861) and Heinrich Wenz (1863–1943). Died 2 Apr 1872. A Joseph [Wenz?] witnessed Friedrich's 1862 marriage.

Maria Anna and her husband Joseph Wenz stood by her brother Friedrich's young family. Joseph Wenz, shoemaker, was godfather to Friedrich's first son in Jan 1862 ([R4-S2]). In May 1864 'M. Anna Mayer, wife of Joseph Wenz, citizen and shoemaker' was godmother, alongside Friedrich himself, to the illegitimate daughter of her youngest sister Paulina ([R4-S1]).
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1590 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, civil-register duplicates/Standesbücher 1810–1839; 549 images; record id 5-480946), births 1821 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-220
